responsibility: Implements gm2’s direct connection to GCC diagnostic output. It maps token numbers to `location_t` values using `M2LexBuf`, dispatches messages to GCC-style `ErrorAtf`, `WarningAtf`, and `NoteAtf`, forwards internal compiler failures to `internal_error`, and re-exports builtins and unknown source locations from `m2linemap` for use by other front-end modules.
same_name_distinction: This implementation module is the concrete GCC-facing side of M2Emit: it maps tokens to `location_t`, dispatches to `ErrorAtf`/`WarningAtf`/`NoteAtf`, calls `internal_error`, and returns linemap locations. The companion `M2Emit.def` only declares that bridge interface.
